checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extract Wang 2021 game-based training meta-analysis and ground the Settings clock option in its non-time-pressure finding

impact_assessment.why: The app makes the session clock optional but gives no evidence context; Wang 2021 (15 RCTs) found game-based training gains and that non-time-pressure formats were preferable.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds three pooled effects and links the pacing choice to the literature without claiming a personal target.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one evidence record + settings note + test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via PubMed efetch, update counts/references/prose, add a linked note with a UI test, run all suites and review the UI.
